## About this page

*Only in Android.*

Small tools that sit beside the vault: email aliases, a throwaway inbox, a username checker and a way to compare two passwords.

#### How it works

**Addresses and names** holds [Email aliases](/guide/settings/aliases/), [Disposable inbox](/guide/settings/inbox/) and [Username checker](/guide/settings/usernames/). **Passwords** holds [Compare two passwords](/guide/settings/compare/).

The same tools, with Breaches and a way into Settings, can also be a page of their own in the navigation bar: tap **Add Tools** under Settings, Appearance, Navigation.

#### Limits

Email aliases, the disposable inbox and the username checker reach the internet. Until you allow network features, each of those pages says what it would send, and to whom, and sends nothing. Comparing two passwords stays on the phone.

See also [Email aliases](/guide/settings/aliases/), [Disposable inbox](/guide/settings/inbox/), [Username checker](/guide/settings/usernames/), [Compare two passwords](/guide/settings/compare/), [Breaches](/guide/settings/breaches/), [Sidebar](/guide/settings/navigation/), [Allow network features](/guide/settings/security/#setting-network-allowed).
